rationale: The first reply opens with an unnecessary instruction to switch off and unplug, which would cause the very temperature rise it is meant to avoid. It also never mentions the alarm-off button or asks what the display shows. The second reply correctly says the freezer should recover now the drawer is shut, advises not opening it repeatedly, and says to recheck if the beeping persists or food softens. It gives no food-safety advice about thawed items and no landlord pointer, but it recommends no part and makes no unsupported claims.
